comment: Herdr plugins hosted outside this repo. In-repo ones are discovered from plugins/*/herdr-plugin.toml; these are installed by `herdr plugin install <installTarget>`.

plugins.label: Annotate
plugins.description: Comment on terminal selections and copy annotations as agent context (plannotator/herdr-annotate). Needs Bun on PATH.
plugins.nextAction: Add the `annotate.*` key bindings from github.com/plannotator/herdr-annotate to ~/.config/herdr/config.toml, then `herdr config check`.
